MSXY-TI1.azimuth: Sin(Inc) * Sin(AzM) * (Tan(Dip) * Cos(Inc) + Sin(Inc) * Cos(AzM)) / Sqrt(2)

MSXY-TI2.azimuth: Sin(AzM) * (Tan(Dip) * Sin(Inc) * Cos(Inc) - Cos(Inc) * Cos(Inc) * Cos(AzM) - Cos(AzM)) / 2

MSXY-TI3.azimuth: (Cos(Inc) * Cos(AzM) * Cos(AzM) - Cos(Inc) * Sin(AzM) * Sin(AzM) - Tan(Dip) * Sin(Inc) * Cos(AzM)) / 2

XCLA.comment: Tangential Calculation. Singularity when vertical. Formula for MD in metres. Az difference < 180 deg.

errata.source: Internal consistency with the sheet's own XCLA/XCLH azimuth/inclination formulas (iscwsa.net file 809, ISCWSA MWD+SRGM Rev5)
errata.reason: The singularity text multiplies XCLTortuosity by RAD (deg→rad) while the main formula uses it as rad/m; one unit for the variable. The corrected singularity text still differs from the limit of the XCLA azimuth formula at azimuths other than 0; engines should not rely on it.

errata.reason: The singularity text multiplies XCLTortuosity by RAD (deg→rad) while the main formula uses it as rad/m; one unit for the variable. The corrected singularity text still differs from the limit of the XCLA azimuth formula at azimuths other than 0; engines should not rely on it.

XCLH.comment: Tangential Calculation. Formula for MD in metres. Az difference < 180 deg.

ABIXY-TI1.azimuth: Cos(Inc) * Cos(Inc) * Sin(AzM) * (Tan(Dip) * Cos(Inc) + Sin(Inc) * Cos(AzM)) / (GField * (1 - Sin(Inc) * Sin(Inc) * Sin(AzM) * Sin(AzM)))

ABIXY-TI2.azimuth: -(Tan(Dip) * Cos(AzM) - Tan(90 * RAD - Inc)) / (GField * (1 - Sin(Inc) * Sin(Inc) * Sin(AzM) * Sin(AzM)))

ABIZ.azimuth: Sin(Inc) * Cos(Inc) * Sin(AzM) * (Tan(Dip) * Cos(Inc) + Sin(Inc) * Cos(AzM)) / (1 - Sin(Inc) * Sin(Inc) * Sin(AzM) * Sin(AzM)) / GField

ASIXY-TI1.azimuth: -(Sin(Inc) * Cos(Inc) * Cos(Inc) * Sin(AzM) * (Tan(Dip) * Cos(Inc) + Sin(Inc) * Cos(AzM))) / (Sqrt(2) * (1 - Sin(Inc) * Sin(Inc) * Sin(AzM) * Sin(AzM)))

ASIXY-TI2.azimuth: -(Sin(Inc) * Cos(Inc) * Cos(Inc) * Sin(AzM) * (Tan(Dip) * Cos(Inc) + Sin(Inc) * Cos(AzM))) / (2 * (1 - Sin(Inc) * Sin(Inc) * Sin(AzM) * Sin(AzM)))

ASIXY-TI3.azimuth: (Tan(Dip) * Sin(Inc) * Cos(AzM) - Cos(Inc)) / (2 * (1 - Sin(Inc) * Sin(Inc) * Sin(AzM) * Sin(AzM)))

ASIZ.azimuth: Sin(Inc) * Cos(Inc) * Cos(Inc) * Sin(AzM) * (Tan(Dip) * Cos(Inc) + Sin(Inc) * Cos(AzM)) / (1 - Sin(Inc) * Sin(Inc) * Sin(AzM) * Sin(AzM))

MBIXY-TI1.azimuth: -Cos(Inc) * Sin(AzM) / (BField * Cos(Dip) * (1 - Sin(Inc) * Sin(Inc) * Sin(AzM) * Sin(AzM)))

MBIXY-TI2.azimuth: Cos(AzM) / (BField * Cos(Dip) * (1 - Sin(Inc) * Sin(Inc) * Sin(AzM) * Sin(AzM)))

MSIXY-TI1.azimuth: Sin(Inc) * Sin(AzM) * (Tan(Dip) * Cos(Inc) + Sin(Inc) * Cos(AzM)) / (Sqrt(2) * (1 - Sin(Inc) * Sin(Inc) * Sin(AzM) * Sin(AzM)))

MSIXY-TI2.azimuth: Sin(AzM) * (Tan(Dip) * Sin(Inc) * Cos(Inc) - Cos(Inc) * Cos(Inc) * Cos(AzM) - Cos(AzM)) / (2 * (1 - Sin(Inc) * Sin(Inc) * Sin(AzM) * Sin(AzM)))

MSIXY-TI3.azimuth: (Cos(Inc) * Cos(AzM) * Cos(AzM) - Cos(Inc) * Sin(AzM) * Sin(AzM) - Tan(Dip) * Sin(Inc) * Cos(AzM)) / (2 * (1 - Sin(Inc) * Sin(Inc) * Sin(AzM) * Sin(AzM)))

MDI.azimuth: -Sin(Inc) * Sin(AzM) * (Cos(Inc) - Tan(Dip) * Sin(Inc) * Cos(AzM)) / (1 - Sin(Inc) * Sin(Inc) * Sin(AzM) * Sin(AzM))

MFI.azimuth: -Sin(Inc) * Sin(AzM) * (Tan(Dip) * Cos(Inc) + Sin(Inc) * Cos(AzM)) / (1 - Sin(Inc) * Sin(Inc) * Sin(AzM) * Sin(AzM)) / BField

GXY-RN.azimuth: NoiseReductionFactor * Sqrt(1 - Cos(AzT) ^ 2 * Sin(Inc) ^ 2) / (EarthRate * Cos(Lat) * Cos(Inc))
